text:
An energy level diagram for the reaction between substance X and substance Y to form
substance Z is shown.
Z
energy
X + Y
progress of reaction
Which statement is correct?
A
Energy is released as substance Z is formed.
B
Substance Z has more energy than substance X and substance Y.
C
The reaction is exothermic.
D
When substance X and substance Y react, the temperature increases.

options.label: A
options.text: Energy is released as substance Z is formed.

options.label: B
options.text: Substance Z has more energy than substance X and substance Y.

options.label: D
options.text: When substance X and substance Y react, the temperature increases.
